name: Cigarette Smoking
overview: Scripture reveals that God provided every herb and fruit-bearing tree for our nourishment and good use, emphasizing the intended purity and benefit of what we consume (Genesis 1:29). The imagery of smoke rising from God's nostrils in Psalms 18:8 symbolizes His righteous power and judgment, reminding believers that smoke can represent both destruction and impurity. Romans 8:5 contrasts living according to the flesh with living according to the Spirit, encouraging believers to focus on spiritual matters rather than fleshly desires. Together, these verses guide Christians to consider the spiritual implications of habits like cigarette smoking, urging a life led by the Spirit that honors the body God has given.
